name: MRCB
recent: MRCB 正推进以 RM1,578,785,023 现金向 EPF 旗下 Tanjung Wibawa 收购 Bukit Jalil Sentral Property 80% 股权及一批 A 类可赎回优先股，并将在 2025 年 12 月 18 日召开 EGM 寻求股东批准。同期，公司在新西兰奥克兰公布一项价值约 4.57 亿美元（按报道）的酒店与办公楼开发项目，并参与乡村学校提升计划。最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收环比与同比均下降，但净利环比大幅回升。
notable: 拟以 RM1,578,785,023 现金向 EPF 旗下 Tanjung Wibawa 收购 Bukit Jalil Sentral Property 80% 股权及 1,132,930,490 股 A 类可赎回优先股。
将于 2025 年 12 月 18 日召开 EGM，寻求股东批准上述关联方收购。
在新西兰奥克兰公布酒店与办公楼开发项目（媒体报道金额约 4.57 亿美元）。
risks: 上述收购属关联方交易，卖方为 EPF 旗下公司，需在 EGM 获股东批准。
最新季度营收环比下降 45.3%、同比下降 41.4%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收为 MYR174,540,000，环比下降 45.3%、同比下降 41.4%；净利为 MYR14,496,000，环比增长 314.5%、同比下降 3.8%，净利率由上一季的 1.1% 升至 8.3%。

recent_en: MRCB is proceeding with a cash acquisition of an 80% stake in Bukit Jalil Sentral Property and Class A redeemable preference shares from EPF's Tanjung Wibawa for RM1,578,785,023, with an EGM set for 18 Dec 2025 to seek shareholder approval. Meanwhile, it unveiled a hotel and office development in Auckland, New Zealand, and took part in a rural school upgrading programme. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell both QoQ and YoY while net profit rebounded sharply QoQ.
notable_en: Proposed cash acquisition of an 80% stake in Bukit Jalil Sentral Property and 1,132,930,490 Class A redeemable preference shares from EPF's Tanjung Wibawa for RM1,578,785,023.
EGM scheduled for 18 Dec 2025 to seek shareholder approval for the related-party acquisition.
Unveiled a hotel and office development in Auckland, New Zealand (media reported value of about US$457 million).
risks_en: The acquisition is a related-party transaction with an EPF subsidiary and requires shareholder approval at the EGM.
Latest quarter revenue fell 45.3% QoQ and 41.4% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR174,540,000, down 45.3% QoQ and 41.4% YoY; net income was MYR14,496,000, up 314.5% QoQ but down 3.8% YoY, with net margin rising to 8.3% from 1.1% in the prior quarter.
